tools.name: locate2u_get_me
tools.description: Get the user that owns the connected app: name, email, role, time zone. Locate2u API: GET /users/me.

tools.name: locate2u_get_team
tools.description: Get the connected team with its settings and branding. Locate2u API: GET /team.

tools.name: locate2u_list_team_members
tools.description: List the drivers and staff in the team, optionally with their current location. Locate2u API: GET /team-members.

tools.name: locate2u_get_team_member
tools.description: Get one team member by public user id. Locate2u API: GET /team-members/{publicUserId}.

tools.name: locate2u_list_team_regions
tools.description: List the regions of the team. Locate2u API: GET /team-regions.

tools.name: locate2u_list_warehouses
tools.description: List the team's warehouses. Locate2u API: GET /warehouses.

tools.name: locate2u_list_services
tools.description: List all services the team offers. Locate2u API: GET /services.

tools.name: locate2u_list_customers
tools.description: List the team's customers. Locate2u API: GET /customers.

tools.name: locate2u_search_customers
tools.description: Search customers by text (name, company, email, phone). Locate2u API: GET /customers/search.

tools.name: locate2u_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id. Locate2u API: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: locate2u_search_orders
tools.description: Search orders by order number, purchase order number, status, payment status, customer or date. Locate2u API: GET /orders/search.

tools.name: locate2u_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by id. Locate2u API: GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: locate2u_find_order
tools.description: Find a single order by its order number, or by a source and source reference pair. Locate2u API: GET /orders.

tools.name: locate2u_list_orders_created
tools.description: List orders created between two dates, optionally with stops and items. Locate2u API: GET /orders/created.

tools.name: locate2u_get_stop
tools.description: Get one stop (a delivery or pickup) with status, contact, address and time window. Locate2u API: GET /stops/{id}.

tools.name: locate2u_search_stops
tools.description: Find stops by the source reference that the integration stored on them. Locate2u API: GET /stops/search.

tools.name: locate2u_list_scheduled_stops
tools.description: List stops scheduled for a day (default: today in the team's zone), with paging. Locate2u API: GET /stops/scheduled.

tools.name: locate2u_list_unassigned_stops
tools.description: List stops that no driver has yet. Locate2u API: GET /stops/unassigned.

tools.name: locate2u_list_stop_notes
tools.description: List all notes on a stop, with attachments. Locate2u API: GET /stops/{id}/notes.

tools.name: locate2u_get_stop_pod_answers
tools.description: Get the answers a driver gave to the proof-of-delivery questions on a stop. Locate2u API: GET /stops/{id}/podquestionanswers.

tools.name: locate2u_get_shipment
tools.description: Get a shipment with its pickup and drop stops and items. Locate2u API: GET /shipments/{id}.

tools.name: locate2u_list_unassigned_shipments
tools.description: List shipments that no team member has yet. Locate2u API: GET /shipments/unassigned.

tools.name: locate2u_list_shipment_notes
tools.description: List all notes on a shipment. Locate2u API: GET /shipments/{id}/notes.

tools.name: locate2u_get_team_trips_summary
tools.description: Summary of every trip in the team on a day: driver, distance, time, stop counts, status. Locate2u API: GET /team/trips/{tripDate}.

tools.name: locate2u_list_team_trips
tools.description: All trips (assigned and unassigned) for a day, each with its driver and stops. Locate2u API: GET /trips/team/{tripDate}.

tools.name: locate2u_get_driver_trip
tools.description: Get the trip of one team member on a day, optionally filtered by status. Locate2u API: GET /trips/user/{publicUserId}/{tripDate}.

tools.name: locate2u_get_trip
tools.description: Get one trip by id with its stops. Locate2u API: GET /trips/id/{id}.

tools.name: locate2u_list_runs
tools.description: List the runs scheduled for a day, optionally for one team member, customer or run number. Locate2u API: GET /runs/{tripDate}.

tools.name: locate2u_team_travel_statistics
tools.description: Distance and time driven by the team's members and asset groups over a date range. Locate2u API: GET /team/reports/travel-statistics.

tools.name: locate2u_list_customer_ratings
tools.description: Delivery ratings that customers left for the team's stops over a date range. Locate2u API: GET /team/{teamId}/customer-ratings.

tools.name: locate2u_search_items
tools.description: Search inventory items by keyword, warehouse or status. Locate2u API: GET /items/search.

tools.name: locate2u_get_item
tools.description: Get one inventory item by id. Locate2u API: GET /items/{id}.

tools.name: locate2u_add_stop_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a text note to a stop. It is visible to the team and the driver. Each call adds a new note (do not retry blindly). Locate2u API: POST /stops/{id}/notes.

tools.name: locate2u_add_shipment_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a text note to a shipment, optionally tied to one of its stops. Each call adds a new note (do not retry blindly). Locate2u API: POST /shipments/{id}/notes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: locate2u_get_me, locate2u_search_customers · Private data: locate2u_get_stop · Public sink: locate2u_get_me, locate2u_search_customers, locate2u_add_stop_note, locate2u_add_shipment_note · Destructive: locate2u_get_shipment, locate2u_list_runs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: locate2u_get_me, locate2u_search_customers · Private data: locate2u_get_stop · Public sink: locate2u_get_me, locate2u_search_customers, locate2u_add_stop_note, locate2u_add_shipment_note · Destructive: locate2u_get_shipment, locate2u_list_runs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
